completed_items: Traced current Python ODIN inspection, ODINC restore, guarded restore, Make Image, and packaging paths
Confirmed legacy header, codecs, CRC, used-block bitmap, and split-set behavior from C++ source
Inspected the clean local ODIN v1.0 all-block fixture without writing to disk

findings: Python currently handles only uncompressed all-block ODIN payloads directly.
Legacy compression ID 1 uses a zlib stream despite the GZip label.
Native read/restore needs all legacy codecs and used-block bitmap decoding; native creation can safely remain all-block.
lz4 and zstandard Python runtime packages are not currently installed or packaged.
next_steps: Human review and approval of Phase 1.
After approval, implement only the format library and conformance fixtures first.
risks: Compressed, used-block, and split compatibility cannot be claimed until golden/oracle fixtures cover those cells.
data.summary: Completed repository-grounded native Python ODIN compatibility and compression plan; awaiting human approval.
